title.zh-TW: 未提供更新重點，標籤比對查無內容
title.en: No Update Highlights Provided, Tag Comparison Found No Content

body.zh-TW: 如果你想知道這版更新了什麼，目前提供的資料還無法確認重點。因為本次提供的 PR 索引（PR index，記錄程式碼修改與合併紀錄的清單）完全空白。連線到 GitHub 比對版本標籤（tag，標記特定軟體版本的記號）的功能也無法查詢。該比對頁面直接回傳了 404 錯誤代碼（網頁伺服器表示找不到該頁面的狀態碼）。⟦像走進展覽館翻開隨附的導覽手冊，展品索引頁面剛好一片空白，掃描牆上的導覽連結也跳出失效畫面，讓人暫時無法查知具體的展出項目。⟧由於來源清單空白且標籤比對頁面失效，目前無法確認本版的更新重點。
body.en: If you want to know what changed in this release, the currently provided information cannot confirm the highlights. This is because the provided PR index is completely blank. Connecting to GitHub to compare version tags also fails to return any information. The comparison page directly returned a 404 error code. ⟦A visitor walks into an exhibition hall and opens the accompanying guidebook only to find the exhibit index blank, while scanning the guide link on the wall brings up a broken page, making it impossible to check the specific exhibits for now.⟧ Because the source list is blank and the tag comparison page is unavailable, the update highlights for this release cannot be confirmed at this time.

items.original: Release highlights could not be determined: the supplied PR index is empty, and the GitHub tag comparison returned 404.
